thesis: The speaker argues that successful investors should adopt an opportunistic approach without a rigid game plan, prioritizing an empty calendar to gain the flexibility and time necessary for reading and thinking. He emphasizes that this ability to maintain an open schedule is a side effect of being great at saying no to requests that do not align with one's goals.
